name: Power transformer core, winding and tank materials
description: Power transformer core, winding and tank materials named on a page read in the GEG gap-fill for Power transformers.

specifications.basis: CG Power Systems 'Power Transformers' catalogue, OCR excerpt 'POWER TRANSFORMERS, CORE BUILDING'. Read 2026-11-25. (value: CRGO low-loss silicon steel laminations; Hi-B grade and laser scribed lamination)
CG Power Systems catalogue summary, 'Winding Process'. Read 2026-11-25. (value: Electrolytic grade copper or epoxy bonded continuously transposed conductor (CTC)
CG Power Systems catalogue summary, 'Winding Process'. Read 2026-11-25. (value: High-quality insulation and thermally upgraded paper for emergency overloading)
CG Power Systems catalogue summary, 'Tanks and Construction' and 'Painting and Finishing'. Read 2026-11-25. (value: Mild steel tanks designed to withstand full vacuum; zinc-rich primer with option)
